{{Youmay|the instrument called valahorn|the instrument called [[valachord]] that [[Tobias Beckett]] wanted to learn how to play}}
[[File:Valahorn.jpg|thumb|250px]]
The '''valahorn''' was a type of musical instrument that was similar in appearance and sound to a [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo horn]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> It was discovered in<ref name="MMGtMI">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80153|text=Music Makers: Guide to Musical Instruments}}</ref> [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> by an archaeological team that was investigating the [[Massassi Temple]]s on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Although its origin was unknown, they theorized that it had been taken to Yavin 4 during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="MMGtMI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The valahorn was an item in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCOA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The valahorn was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 2|Game Update 2]]," on [[March 13]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 2">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67648&month=032008|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 2}}</ref>
